_about: Email-address merge tags for the landing page's merge tag tool. build-landing.mjs renders every entry into automated-donor-journeys/index.html (AUTO:MERGETAGS) and refuses any entry without a tag and an official source. Each tag is confirmed in the vendor's own documentation, because a wrong tag silently stops personalization for a whole send. Where a vendor documents a different form for links (Kit's url_encode filter, GetResponse's CONTACT syntax), the link form is used. Left out on purpose, because no exact tag could be confirmed in official docs or the platform has no fixed tag (the page's custom tag box covers them): Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys, Oracle Eloqua, Mailjet, iContact, Zoho Campaigns, Bloomerang, Blackbaud Raiser's Edge NXT, Blackbaud eTapestry, Blackbaud Luminate Online (S-tags aren't filled in inside tracked links), Neon CRM, Virtuous, DonorPerfect, Givebutter, Keela, Donorbox, Bonterra Engage, Kindful, Bloomerang Fundraising (Qgiv). Most of these insert the email field from a picker with no documented text tag, which the page's hint under the custom box covers.
